import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark_runner', root / 'scripts/run_wsl_benchmarks.py')
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
tools = runner.check_prerequisites(root)
output = root / 'build/gobo-update-2026-11-13/shared-ecf'
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
report_path = output / 'results.json'
report_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
tuning = sorted(name for name in os.environ if name.startswith(('GC_', 'EIF_')))
if tuning:
    raise RuntimeError('Review inherited GC/runtime settings before timing: ' + ', '.join(tuning))
report = {
    'gobo': tools['gobo_version'], 'eiffelstudio': tools['eiffel_version'],
    'gobo_root': tools['gobo_root'], 'gc_runtime_override_names': tuning,
    'ecf': str(root / 'benchmarks/xpact_benchmarks.ecf'),
    'ecf_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'benchmarks/xpact_benchmarks.ecf').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'note': 'Unmodified EiffelStudio ECF; no explicit GC selection or external optimization flag added.',
    'builds': []
}
for mode in runner.build_specs(['Finalized', 'FinalizedAssertions']):
    project = output / mode.name
    project.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    command = [tools['gec'], '--finalize', '--cc=no', '--target=' + mode.target, report['ecf']]
    print('Checking shared ECF: ' + mode.name, flush=True)
    runner.run_checked(command, cwd=project, env=tools['gobo_environment'], log_path=project/'eiffel.log')
    generated = project / '.gobo'
    script = generated / 'xpact_benchmarks.sh'
    text = script.read_text()
    assert '-O2' in text, 'Default optimization missing'
    headers = '\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in generated.glob('*.h'))
    assert '#define GE_USE_BOEHM_GC' in headers, 'Default Boehm selection missing'
    runner.run_checked([tools['sh'], '-e', script], cwd=generated, env=tools['gobo_environment'], log_path=project/'c.log')
    executable = generated / 'xpact_benchmarks'
    runner.require_linux_executable(executable, 'shared ECF Gobo benchmark', elf=True)
    run_output = runner.run_checked([executable, '--iterations', '100'], env=tools['gobo_environment'])
    report['builds'].append({
        'mode': mode.name, 'command': [str(x) for x in command],
        'generated_c_script': text, 'default_gc': 'boehm',
        'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'iterations': 100, 'output': run_output, 'passed': True
    })
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Both unchanged ECF targets build/run with default -O2 and Boehm GC.', flush=True)

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import statistics

repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark_runner', repo/'scripts/run_wsl_benchmarks.py')
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
tools = runner.check_prerequisites(repo, ['Gobo'])
root = repo/'build/gobo-update-2026-11-13/shared-ecf'
qualification = json.loads((root/'results.json').read_text())
destination = root/'timings.json'
destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
report = {'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'version':tools['gobo_version'],
          'iterations':10000, 'repetitions':5, 'warmups_per_engine':1,
          'purpose':'Supplemental normal-GC control using unchanged EiffelStudio ECF and its installed Base sources.',
          'rows':[], 'medians_ms':{}}
for build in qualification['builds']:
    mode=build['mode']
    binary=root/mode/'.gobo/xpact_benchmarks'
    assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==build['binary_sha256']
    engine=runner.Engine('Gobo shared ECF '+mode, binary, (), tools['gobo_version'],
                         'Same ECF as EiffelStudio; default GCC -O2 and Boehm; normal GC', tools['gobo_environment'])
    rows=runner.measure_engine(engine,10000,5)
    report['rows'].extend(rows)
    report['medians_ms'][mode]=statistics.median(row['ElapsedMs'] for row in rows)
report['completed_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
destination.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['medians_ms']),flush=True)

        end

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "linux"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
REPORT = OUT / "results.json"
REPORT.unlink(missing_ok=True)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("probe", REPO / "tools/compiler_assertions/run_probe.py")
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(probe)
probe.SOURCE = ROOT / "source"
original_config = probe.config_text

def no_extra_cflags(compiler, selection):
    document = ET.fromstring(original_config(compiler, selection))
    ns = "{" + probe.NAMESPACE + "}"
    target = document.find(ns + "target")
    for flag in target.findall(ns + "external_cflag"):
        target.remove(flag)
    return ET.tostring(document, encoding="unicode")

probe.config_text = no_extra_cflags
environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
               if not key.startswith(("GOBO_CLI_", "GOBO_DEFAULT_"))}
for key in ("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "LD_PRELOAD", "LIBRARY_PATH", "CPATH", "C_INCLUDE_PATH",
            "CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH", "BOEHM_GC"):
    environment.pop(key, None)
environment.update(GOBO_CC="gcc", GOBO_EIFFEL="ge", LC_ALL="C")
report = {"compilers": {}, "cases": [], "gobo_generated_build_scripts": {},
          "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256((probe.SOURCE / "assertion_probe.e").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "explicit_cflags": []}
for compiler, tool, argument in (("Gobo", "gec", "--version"), ("EiffelStudio", "ec", "-version")):
    version = probe.checked([tool, argument], OUT, environment, OUT / (compiler + "-version.log"))
    report["compilers"][compiler] = {"path": shutil.which(tool), "version": version}
    for selection in ("all_off", "all_on"):
        executable, directory = probe.build(compiler, selection, OUT, environment)
        if compiler == "Gobo":
            report["gobo_generated_build_scripts"][selection] = (executable.parent / "assertion_probe.sh").read_text()
        for mode in ("literal", "dynamic"):
            result = probe.run([executable, mode], directory, environment, directory / (mode + ".log"), 15)
            completed = "LITERAL_PROBE_COMPLETED " + mode in result.stdout
            detected = result.returncode != 0 and "Postcondition violated" in result.stdout and "ASSERTION_PROBE" in result.stdout and not completed
            valid = detected or (result.returncode == 0 and completed)
            expected = mode == "literal" or selection == "all_on"
            row = {"compiler": compiler, "selection": selection, "mode": mode,
                   "expected_detection": expected, "detected": detected, "completed": completed,
                   "matches": valid and detected == expected, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                   "diagnostic": result.stdout,
                   "executable_sha256": hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
            report["cases"].append(row)
            print(compiler, selection, mode, "PASS" if row["matches"] else "FAIL", flush=True)
report["all_match"] = all(row["matches"] for row in report["cases"])
staging = REPORT.with_suffix(".staging")
staging.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
staging.replace(REPORT)
print(REPORT, flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["all_match"] else 1)
